name: The Guardian Open Platform API
notes: Exceptional for AI use: provides FULL article body text (not just snippets), rich metadata, tags, contributors, and section classifications. Archives back to 1999. Free for non-commercial use. One of the most generous free news APIs — high daily limit, full content access. Structured tag system enables topic-based filtering. Register for a free developer key at https://open-platform.theguardian.com/access/
